summary: Implemented Export Code dialog with multi-format export capabilities for generated workflow code

changes.description: Template generators for npm package scaffolding: generatePackageJson, generateTsConfig, generateReadme, generateTestScaffold, sanitizePackageName
Code export service with exportAsFile (single .ts download), exportAsPackage (ZIP with full npm project), exportAsGist (GitHub API), validateForExport, extractDependencies, createZipBlob
Modal dialog component with format selection (file/package/gist), validation display, export options (dependencies, tests, package name, GitHub token), and result feedback
Added ExportHistoryEntry type, exportHistory state array, addExportRecord and clearExportHistory actions, sessionStorage persistence for export history
Added 'Code' export button with code generation (API with fallback), ExportDialog integration, and export history tracking via onExportComplete callback
34 tests covering generatePackageJson, generateTsConfig, generateReadme, generateTestScaffold, sanitizePackageName
30 tests covering validateForExport, extractDependencies, generateFilename, exportAsFile, exportAsPackage, exportAsGist, createZipBlob
21 tests covering rendering, validation, format selection, close behavior, export action, and options checkboxes

test_results.note: The single failure (planStore createAgent worker test) is pre-existing and unrelated to this change
